title: 3D Models
author: praneth2580
headline: Motorcycle gear you can print yourself, free to download
intro: Open-source, parametric 3D-printable designs: a phone navigation dock and a round display pod for the Royal Enfield Meteor 350, adjustable for other bikes and hardware. Download the STLs, or change the measurements and make your own.
disclaimer: Prototypes, not road-tested products. Not affiliated with Royal Enfield. Mount anything on a vehicle so it never blocks the steering, controls or your view, and follow your local rules.
